messages:
maya: Quick note: sample-app CI broke after autogen update. Mypy errors when iterating response.payload because generator produced Optional[Union[List[WidgetA], List[WidgetB], NoneType]] instead of Optional[List[Union[WidgetA, WidgetB]]]

maya: example from generated models:
```python
class WidgetsResp(BaseModel):
    payload: Optional[Union[List[WidgetA], List[WidgetB]]] = None
```

maya: consumption pattern in sample app: `flat = [i for col in (resp.payload or []) for i in col]` -> mypy: "Item \"None\" of \"Optional[Union[List[WidgetA], List[WidgetB]]]" has no attribute "__iter__"

owen: hmm. pyright in local env doesn't complain but CI mypy pinned to 0.991 does. This is a typing surface issue, not runtime

tara: seems autogen is choosing union-of-lists instead of list-of-union. We should normalize to List[Union[...]] when multiple item schemas are present. That makes downstream code much simpler

maya: short-term workaround: use `cast(List[Union[WidgetA, WidgetB]], resp.payload or [])` or change comprehension to `for col in (resp.payload or [])` and add `# type: ignore` for the line. Not ideal for docs

owen: longer-term: add generator config `normalize_array_unions=true` default true and emit a top-level alias `WidgetsPayload = List[Union[WidgetA, WidgetB]]`. Keep private original shape for fidelity but export nicer public types

tara: also saw related mismatch: sync client returns Sequence[Widget] and async returns AsyncIterator[Widget]. Recommend we add a Generic client protocol so both variants share a common typed method signature. This avoids overload confusion in user code

ci-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/428 - "autogen: normalize array unions to improve typing ergonomics"

doc-bot: Documentation note created in draft: docs/sdk/upgrading-typing.md referencing the issue and suggesting cast/workaround examples for users

maya: I'll add a small repro to the SDK tests that runs mypy+pyright on a generated package so we catch regressions across versions

owen: please include both pyright and multiple mypy pins in the CI matrix. Some users run older pins and we need compatibility checks

tara: assigning generator PR to @owen; maya will add tests and docs. Thanks all
